title: Jesus Feeds Five Thousand
summary: Jesus can use small gifts and provide more than enough. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.

read_it.prompt: Read John 6:1-14 and look for how this passage teaches: Jesus can use small gifts and provide more than enough.

tell_it: A boy had five loaves and two fish. Jesus gave thanks and fed a huge crowd with leftovers.
understand_it: Jesus can use small gifts and provide more than enough. This lesson keeps the main point simple: God is faithful, His Word is true, and His people can respond with faith and obedience.
age_5_7_explanation: Jesus Feeds Five Thousand reminds us that God is good and we can trust Him. Provision matters.
age_8_11_explanation: Jesus Feeds Five Thousand shows that following God is not only knowing the story. It means learning this truth: Jesus can use small gifts and provide more than enough.
teen_explanation: Jesus Feeds Five Thousand gives older students room to think about faith under pressure. The passage teaches that jesus can use small gifts and provide more than enough. It also asks how belief becomes action.
key_truths: Jesus can use small gifts and provide more than enough.
God is faithful and His people can trust Him.
life_application: A kid can practice this when provision is needed: at school, with siblings, during disappointment, or when choosing between an easy wrong thing and a harder right thing.

quiz_questions.question: What food did the boy have?
quiz_questions.explanation: The passage points us back to this answer: Five loaves and two fish. It helps kids remember the main event and the truth it teaches.

quiz_questions.question: This lesson teaches that jesus can use small gifts and provide more than enough.
quiz_questions.explanation: That is the plain lesson focus for this passage, stated in kid-friendly language.

memory_verse.prompt: Remember John 6:9 as a short anchor for this lesson.

discussion_questions: What happened in Jesus Feeds Five Thousand?
What does this passage teach us about God or following Him?
Where could this lesson help you at home, school, church, or with friends?

activity.title: Lunch Basket
activity.instructions: Draw or act out the lesson scene, then name the one clear truth: Jesus can use small gifts and provide more than enough.

prayer_prompt: Lord, help me learn from Jesus Feeds Five Thousand. Teach me to trust You, listen to Your Word, and live this truth this week.
